description: GET /users/{userId}/recordings query recording_source_type declares string default "null" and documents that literal as the all-recordings mode, but its enum lists only cloud_recording_only and my_notes_recording_only. Add the already documented literal string "null" to that enum, retaining the default, example, complete parameter and both existing alternatives. The current official Meetings page embeds the same parameter. No JSON null coercion, fabricated mode or default removal; assert the full original parameter and operation identity before replay.

from.name: userId
from.description: The user's ID or email address. For user-level apps, pass the `me` value.

from.name: page_size
from.description: The number of records returned within a single API call.

from.name: next_page_token
from.description: The next page token paginates through a large set of results. A next page token returns whenever the set of available results exceeds the current page size. The expiration period for this token is 15 minutes.

from.name: mc
from.description: The query metadata of the recording if using an on-premise meeting connector for the meeting.

from.name: trash
from.description:
The query trash.
* `true` - List recordings from trash.  
* `false` - Do not list recordings from the trash.  

The default value is `false`. If you set it to `true`, you can use the `trash_type` property to indicate the type of Cloud recording that you need to retrieve.

from.name: from
from.description:
The start date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' UTC format for the date range where you would like to retrieve recordings. The maximum range can be a month. If no value is provided for this field, the default will be current date. 

For example, if you make the API request on June 30, 2020, without providing the `from` and `to` parameters, by default the value of 'from' field will be `2020-06-30` and the value of the 'to' field will be `2020-07-01`. 

**Note**: The `trash` files cannot be filtered by date range and thus, the `from` and `to` fields should not be used for trash files.

from.name: to
from.description: The end date in 'yyyy-mm-dd' 'yyyy-mm-dd' UTC format.

from.name: trash_type
from.description:
The type of cloud recording to retrieve from the trash. 
 
 *   `meeting_recordings`: List all meeting recordings from the trash.  
 *  `recording_file`: List all individual recording files from the trash.

from.name: zra_status
from.description:
The Zoom Revenue Accelerator (ZRA) analysis status of a recording.

* `all` - all Revenue Accelerator status.
*  `added`: added to Revenue Accelerator.
*  `not_added`: not added to Revenue Accelerator.
*  `processing`: processing Revenue Accelerator analysis.

from.name: recording_source_type
from.description:
* `null` - Return all recordings, including cloud recordings and My Notes recordings.
* `cloud_recording_only` - Return only cloud recordings.
* `my_notes_recording_only` - Return only My Notes recordings.
